subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Victor Lustig: The Smoothest Con Man
description: A micro-lesson that makes Victor Lustig: The Smoothest Con Man usable.

hook.text: Victor Lustig sold the Eiffel Tower for scrap metal — twice — and was never reported.

buildup.text: He posed as a French government official, hosting private meetings with Parisian scrap dealers.

discovery.text: Lustig targeted the most insecure bidder, who paid a bribe on top of the purchase price.

twist.text: Both victims were too embarrassed to go to police. Shame was part of the con's design.

climax.text: Lustig's cons worked because he made victims feel privileged to be chosen.

punchline.text: He didn't sell metal. He sold the feeling of a deal.

quiz.question: Why didn't Lustig's victims report the Eiffel Tower scam?
options: They didn't realize it was a scam
